boundaries: This notice and locator are communication evidence only and grant no permission, task selection, execution authority, promotion authority, publication authority, or release authority.

Do not treat candidate-local implementation or passing prototype validation as synchronized governance, production proof, canonical ontology authority, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
Do not backdate, synthesize, or imply per-SWU Task Session, Invoke Refresh, closeout, or terminal receipts that were not actually produced by their declared owners.
Do not cross the private DomainSpec and cyberAlchemy-v2 boundary into public Arcanum artifacts during reconciliation.
This notice does not authorize changes to product code, planning files, AGENTS.md, Arcanum source or generated skills, Git state, remote transports, or external systems.
key_points: The active candidate Work Pack is WP-ARE-ENUM-TS-001. It defines a 15-SWU path from ontology and obligation contracts through TypeScript generation, independent proof mechanics, replay, and exit assessment.

The latest implementation-readiness result passed only as an audit for SWU-ARE-004 at plan epoch epoch-3f898f252d40dc4486f7a0eb; it selected no unit, opened no Task Session, ran no product command, and made no product or authority mutation.

Candidate-local prototype execution may proceed in Work Pack order while deferring per-SWU readiness, Task Session admission, Invoke Refresh, closeout synchronization, lifecycle receipts, and promotion bookkeeping.

Validation is not deferred. The prototype lane must preserve the Work Pack's unit, integration, generation, whitespace, browser, semantic, privacy, and exact-scope acceptance checks that apply to the implemented bytes.

After prototype validation, reconciliation must be based on the actual changed files, validation outputs, and surviving evidence. Missing lifecycle records must remain identified as missing until their proper owners produce them; they must not be backdated or inferred from passing prototype tests.

next_actions.action: Finish the bounded Enum meta-type implementation and produce one consolidated validation report with exact changed-file and command evidence.
After prototype validation, inventory the exact implemented delta and map each skipped lifecycle artifact to its declared owner and current Work Pack state.
Run the minimum truthful reconciliation route for readiness, Task Session, Invoke Refresh, closeout, and receipts, explicitly recording any evidence that cannot be reconstructed.
Evaluate promotion separately only after lifecycle reconciliation; preserve candidate-local status unless and until that owner grants promotion.

open_calls.question: After the prototype validation report exists, what exact bounded sequence will reconcile the deferred per-SWU readiness, Task Session, Invoke Refresh, closeout, terminal receipt, and Work Pack status records without fabricating historical execution evidence?
Does any reconciled candidate evidence merit promotion beyond local prototype status? Prototype validation alone does not answer or authorize this decision.
